questions.question: Describe two important early events in space travel, with their years.
questions.expected_answer: Any two: in 1957 the first satellite was launched into space; in 1961 Yuri Gagarin became the first person to travel into space, flying once around the Earth; in 1963 Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman in space.

questions.question: Describe what happened during the Apollo Eleven mission in 1969.
questions.expected_answer: A huge Saturn Five rocket carried three astronauts into space. They travelled for about three days to the Moon. Michael Collins stayed in the main spacecraft flying around the Moon, while Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed. Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the Moon. They collected rocks, took photographs and did experiments, then all three returned safely to the Earth.

questions.question: Give two ways people use space and rockets today.
questions.expected_answer: Any two: astronauts from many countries live and work on the International Space Station; rockets launch satellites that help with weather reports, television, phone calls and maps; rockets send robot spacecraft and rovers to explore other planets like Mars.
